title: Subset Enumeration
statement:
Enumerate all subsets in increasing bitmask order. Bit i represents element i+1.

Input
n, then n distinct integers.

Output
For each mask from 0 to 2ⁿ−1, print the subset size followed by its elements in input order. The empty subset is printed as 0.

Constraints
0 ≤ n ≤ 16. Values have absolute value at most 10⁶.
